name: @absolutejs/voice-azure
description: Azure Speech (Cognitive Services) adapter for @absolutejs/voice — Neural TTS shipped, streaming STT next
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @absolutejs/voice && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run build && bun publish --access public
